column1: BIOL2401 Lab Practical # 1 SLO
Ex 1 - Be able to describe the anatomical position.
Ex 1 - Know the anatomical terminology used to describe parts of the body.
Ex 1 - Identify the cavities of the body and organs found in each cavity.
Ex 1 - Identify abdominopelvic body regions and quadrants.
Ex 1 - Be able to recognize body planes and sections.
Ex 2 - Know the difference between ionic and covalent bonds.
Ex 2 - Know the definition of electrolytes.
Ex 2 - Understand the concept of atomic bonding.
Ex 2 - Define pH.
Ex 2 - Define and give examples of common acids and bases in our body.
Ex 2 - Define buffers.
